title: Tasmia
tagline: tasmia aims to be a data labeling dao in addition to a marketplace for data
description:
one of the first projects i worked on was labling car pictures for computer vision models, so all the talk about data, data dao, nft, deals..etc made me realize there need to be labeling data dao, to take advantage of this new and exciting ecosystem thats the fevm is about unleash. 

for this hackthon i have only created a simple labeling tool ,but i plan to work further on this project and see where it will lead.
how_its_made: the contract are deplyed on the fevm, the frontend is created using vue, in addition to D3.js for the data labeling and the visualization of the csv files.. im still working on connecting the tasmia with a wallet and inteacting with the smartcontract and also add web3storage for the files uploaded
